Step by step (do it once per account; 3 accounts):
A) On each Claude account (claude.ai/code/routines): open 'Vigilant rotation' > menu next to its name > Edit > 'Add another trigger' > API. Save. Open it again: it shows a URL like https://api.anthropic.com/v1/claude_code/routines/trig_XXXX/fire. Copy that URL, then tap 'Generate token' and copy the token NOW (shown once).
B) In GitHub (github.com/tjshea90/novig, in a browser): Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions > 'New repository secret'. Make two secrets per account:
 name CLAUDE_FIRE_7542BF_URL = the URL; name CLAUDE_FIRE_7542BF_TOKEN = the token. (7542BF is the account whose routine you just edited.)
 Same for the other two accounts using 27A37E and 5D1E2D.
C) Optional but needed for chat mode: in each routine's prompt, add at the end the paragraph starting 'If the fire text starts with CHAT:' from research/coordination/ROUTINE_PROMPT.txt in the repo.
Which account is which? The tag is the account's code: tell me which email each is and I'll map them, or just do A-B on each; a wrong pairing only wakes the wrong account's turn order, nothing breaks. Never paste a token into this chat.
